text:
No option can be put forward from this run because the salary constraint was not assessable.

- The limit is **Annual salary spend ≤ £400k/year**, but the model produces that factor as a calculated change rather than a comparable annual-spend level; it was therefore excluded from the comparison.
- The comparison is **very fragile** and outcomes were almost indistinguishable. It also assumes that more platform-delivery progress is better, rather than recording that objective explicitly.
- The ordering is most sensitive to **delivery capacity**—an Olumi estimate, not user evidence. The model includes six machine-supplied values, so this is a provisional result rather than validation.

The key repair is to define which model component the £400k/year limit applies to in a directly comparable level frame.
